manifest.name: teammate-assignment
manifest.description: One assignment of one teammate agent (backlog:8986f4459f0f): the original human phrase plus the machine schedule it became (cadence and next run). Created from a phrase with an explicit plan (the fake-AI seam) or the built-in Italian parser; an unclear phrase refuses instead of guessing. (backlog:8986f4459f0f)

migrations.name: create_teammate_assignments
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS teammate_assignments (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  space_id TEXT,
  agent_source_key TEXT,
  phrase TEXT,
  cadence TEXT CHECK(cadence IN ('daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'once')),
  weekday INTEGER,
  time_of_day TEXT,
  run_at TEXT,
  next_run_at TEXT,
  last_run_at TEXT,
  cost_per_run_cents INTEGER,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('active', 'paused', 'completed')),
  decided_at TEXT,
  actor_type TEXT CHECK(actor_type IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  actor_id TEXT,
  source_package TEXT,
  source_action TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS teammate_assignments_space_id ON teammate_assignments(space_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS teammate_assignments_agent_source_key ON teammate_assignments(agent_source_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS teammate_assignments_source_package ON teammate_assignments(source_package);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_teammate_assignments
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."teammate_assignments" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "space_id" TEXT,
  "agent_source_key" TEXT,
  "phrase" TEXT,
  "cadence" TEXT CHECK("cadence" IN ('daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'once')),
  "weekday" BIGINT,
  "time_of_day" TEXT,
  "run_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "next_run_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "last_run_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "cost_per_run_cents" BIGINT,
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('active', 'paused', 'completed')),
  "decided_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "actor_type" TEXT CHECK("actor_type" IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  "actor_id" TEXT,
  "source_package" TEXT,
  "source_action" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "teammate_assignments_space_id"
  ON "accordo"."teammate_assignments"("space_id");

CREATE INDEX "teammate_assignments_agent_source_key"
  ON "accordo"."teammate_assignments"("agent_source_key");

CREATE INDEX "teammate_assignments_source_package"
  ON "accordo"."teammate_assignments"("source_package");
